synthesisNote: Three reviewers (Claude + Codex + Copilot) returned 17 findings — 3 High consensus/near-consensus, 4 Codex-only High, 10 Mediums. All addressed in plan v2 directly by the plan-drafter without invoking review-loop.sh (findings were mechanical fixes — re-wording, extra ACs, command-path corrections — not deliberation-heavy design changes; multi-reviewer signal was already converged). v1 archived as draft-plan-v1.md in staging.

findings.summary: v1 AC6 grep -A0 only verifies first line of multi-line bullet — divergent continuation text would pass
findings.resolution: v2 AC7 uses awk-based bullet-block extractor + diff over the whole bullet body (from the bullet-start line through the next bullet/heading)

findings.summary: v1 AC9 excludes all non-md/json paths from the diff — would fail on the legitimate codex gitlink path bump
findings.resolution: v2 AC11 split into per-repo checks: codex submodule allows only *.md; codexu allows *.md, *.json, the bare 'codex' gitlink path, and .ralph-overview/generated/ regenerated sidecars

findings.summary: v1 split-commit fallback had no guard against wrapper gitlink pointing at the incomplete commit-1 SHA
findings.resolution: v2 Phase 5a split-commit section now includes a wrapper-side gitlink safety check that greps the target commit message for '(incomplete)' and exits non-zero before staging. v2 AC2 verifies the check is present.

findings.summary: v1 Phase 5a command 'source scripts/iteration-env.sh' resolved relative to submodule cwd, would fail
findings.resolution: v2 uses 'source "$REBASE_WORKTREE/scripts/iteration-env.sh"' with wrapper-root absolute path

findings.summary: v1 said 'Push codex submodule commit to gim-home/codex@main' — violates the lead-only-merges-to-main rule
findings.resolution: v2 Implementation Strategy Step 3 explicitly says impl pushes ralph/<task-id> topic branch; lead later FF-merges. Mirrored in v2 Technical Constraints.

findings.summary: v1 only appended H2 sections; numbered workflow steps 5/6 (which agents follow first) didn't reference Phase 5a
findings.resolution: v2 Implementation Strategy Step 1 amends step 5 inline to add the workspace-cargo-check HARD GATE pointer, AND amends step 6 to require Phase 5a as a precondition. v2 AC4 verifies both amendments.

findings.summary: v1 had impl member add command.prompts.impl during impl — but that seed is needed BEFORE the impl spawn
findings.resolution: v2 moves prompts.impl seed to a 'Bookkeeper pre-spawn responsibilities' section; removed from impl scope; AC9 no longer references it

findings.summary: v1 sunset condition was prose-only ('update this section after escalate... ships'); not self-triggering
findings.resolution: v2 Phase 5b now has '### Sunset checklist (self-triggering)' with concrete bookkeeper commands (workflow_dispatch + gh run watch + amend). v2 AC3 verifies the checklist is present. v2 AC10 verifies a cross-link kanbanCards row on the escalate-gim-home-actions-policy task.

findings.summary: v1 worktree placement used codex/../.worktrees — doesn't match the convention table (which says <repo>/.worktrees)
findings.resolution: v2 Step 0 uses codex/.worktrees/<task-id> inside the codex submodule

findings.summary: v1 said 'six files touched' but later said roadmap is post-ship — contradictory
findings.resolution: v2 consistently says 5 files in impl scope; roadmap is bookkeeper post-ship. v2 AC16 enforces no roadmap edit in impl scope.

findings.summary: v1 didn't mention regenerating .ralph-overview/generated/ sidecars after data.json edit
findings.resolution: v2 Implementation Strategy Step 6 + v2 AC17 add the 'node bin/ralph-overview.mjs sync' step and verify sidecars are in-sync with committed state

findings.summary: v1 implied this task exercises Phase 5b interim closeout — but doc-only impl doesn't
findings.resolution: v2 Implementation Strategy Step 10 explicitly states this impl ships the PROTOCOL, not an exercise of the closeout

findings.summary: Proposed new sections are large; could update steps 5-8 + add a shorter summary
findings.resolution: Q4 in Open Questions documents the deliberate decision to keep sections self-contained (future rebase agents read the skill from scratch in a fresh context; click-through assembly is more error-prone). The new sections DO explicitly cross-reference existing sections at their tops to make the relationship visible without forcing bouncing.

findings.summary: v1 AC10 cargo-metadata.out redirect used a bare filename, cwd-dependent
findings.resolution: v2 Implementation Strategy Step 9 uses an absolute JOB_OUT path under .ralph/jobs/.../cargo-metadata.out; v2 AC12 verifies the file is non-empty

findings.summary: v1 data.json warning snippet was multi-line raw string, not valid JSON
findings.resolution: v2 Files to Create/Modify §5 shows the warnings row as proper single-line JSON

findings.summary: v1 AC8 only checked warnings array length >=1; weak — pre-existing warning would mask a missed addition
findings.resolution: v2 AC9 substring-checks both 'escalate-gim-home-actions-policy' AND 'Phase 5b is currently gated' in command.warnings[].html
v2 introductory 'Base commit reference' block before AC1 defines BASE=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) once; all diff ACs use $BASE
